# NextCV - AI Resume Builder for India | ATS-Friendly Resume Maker

NextCV is an AI-powered resume builder designed specifically for Indian job seekers. Create ATS-friendly resumes that pass Applicant Tracking Systems used by companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, HCLTech, Deloitte, Capgemini, Amazon, and many more.

Generate professional resumes in minutes using AI-powered content suggestions, modern resume templates, and recruiter-approved formatting.

Whether you are a fresher, experienced software engineer, MBA graduate, B.Com student, nurse, teacher, or working professional, NextCV helps you build a resume that increases interview opportunities.
